harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and validated the replicated CORP.EXAMPLE Samba AD environment across all four nodes. Authentication, redundant DNS, Kerberos, engineering-share access, controller failover, and restart persistence are proven.
actions_performed: Provisioned node1 and node2 as replicated Samba AD controllers bound to 10.100.194.0/24.
Created engineering and its member infrasetuser, with replication verified.
Joined node3 as a member server and published the writable engineering share with the required welcome.txt.
Joined node4 and created /root/corp-user.env with mode 0600.
Demonstrated authentication, DNS, and SMB access with either controller unavailable.
Rebooted every node individually and verified changed boot IDs and role/data recovery.

evidence.requirement: Replicated CORP.EXAMPLE controllers on the dedicated identity network
evidence.summary: Both controllers are active, publish LDAP/Kerberos through 10.100.194.10/11, have zero database errors, and report zero replication failures.

evidence.requirement: engineering group containing infrasetuser
evidence.summary: Shows object creation, membership, and replicated visibility on node2.

evidence.requirement: node3 engineering share, required content, and member write access
evidence.summary: Shows healthy domain trust, SMB bound to 10.100.194.12, welcome.txt containing infraset-samba, and successful authenticated write round trips.

evidence.requirement: Joined node4 with protected credential environment
evidence.summary: The client join and trust are healthy; /root/corp-user.env is root-owned mode 0600 and persists without exposing its password.

evidence.requirement: Availability while node1 controller is down
evidence.summary: With node1 stopped, node2 provided DNS and fresh Kerberos authentication while SMB read/write remained available; node1 was then restored.

evidence.requirement: Availability while node2 controller is down
evidence.summary: With node2 stopped, node1 provided DNS and a fresh TGT, SMB read/write succeeded, and client trust/password authentication rediscovered node1; node2 was restored.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change, and recovered AD/DNS/data state.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node2 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change, and recovered controller/database/replication state.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node3 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change, restored trust/share data, and authenticated post-reboot SMB write.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node4 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change, persistent credentials, restored trust, fresh Kerberos authentication, DNS, and SMB read/write.
